en.'Jl. Raya Jakarta-Bogor No.12' muncul di: 'Jl. Raya Jakarta-Bogor No.12' appears in 3 different locations tens of kilometres apart.
en.100% manajer hub tersertifikasi dalam 18: 100% of hub managers certified within 18 months
en.20,6% pangsa pasar berdasarkan volume pa: 20.6% market share by parcel volume in 2024, holding market leadership for five consecutive years. Volume rose from 1.14 billion parcels (2023) to 1.46 billion parcels (2024), growth of 28%.
en.5,5 per juta paket = ~6.105 kasus/tahun: 5.5 per million parcels = about 6,105 cases per year out of 1,110 million parcels.
en.68,9% > 65%. Perlu perhatian khusus untu: 68.9% > 65%. Needs particular attention to prevent overload.
en.78% atau lebih selama tiga bulan berturu: 78% or more for three consecutive months
en.8 paket COD butuh 138 menit vs non-COD 7: 8 COD parcels take 138 minutes against 75 minutes for non-COD. Productivity falls from 6.4 to 3.48 parcels per hour.
en.ASUMSI TIM; dokumen memakai basis konser: TEAM ASSUMPTION; the document uses a conservative basis for investment decisions.
en.Address Intelligence (NLP + fuzzy matchi: Address Intelligence (NLP plus fuzzy matching plus mandatory geotagging) plus a multimodal Control Tower plus the Modal Shift Optimizer.
en.Aktifkan notifikasi 3 tahap untuk kurang: Enable three-stage notifications to cut waiting time by 10 to 20 minutes per failed attempt.
en.Alokasi unit EV ke 23 hub berbobot KAPAS: EV units allocated to the 23 hubs weighted by CAPACITY (Table 1): the largest hubs are served first. Per-hub economics use the base replacement scenario. A prioritisation simulation, not an actual assignment.
en.Ambang impas (NPV = 0) menyelesaikan tia: The break-even threshold (NPV = 0) solves each variable in reverse on the base scenario. It shows how much headroom exists before the investment loses value; all simulation, not a guarantee.
en.Angka dasar 75 vs 138 menit dari dokumen: The base figures of 75 against 138 minutes come from the case document; courier cost, idle CO2, and intervention shares are team assumptions (prototype).
en.Antar normal, penerima siap bayar: Normal delivery, recipient ready to pay
en.Apa beda Direct Operation dan Regional S: What is the difference between Direct Operation and Regional Sponsor?
en.Apa beda kedua model itu?: What is the difference between the two models?
en.Apakah GC Logistics untung atau rugi?: Is GC Logistics profitable or loss-making?
en.Armada tetap di persentil-70 permintaan: Fixed fleet at the 70th percentile of monthly demand, not the peak.
en.Arus kas PROGRAM (capex fase jatuh Y1/Y2: PROGRAM cash flow (phase capex falls in Y1/Y2/Y3, benefits after units are deployed), unlike per-phase cash flow. A staged rollout planning simulation.
en.Aturan pecah mengikuti dokumen: utilisas: The split rule follows the document: base utilisation times amplification above 100 percent. Load-balancing cost (8-tonne truck = 4,000 parcels, 120 km, Rp3,000/km), new-hub capex, and layer shares are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled).
en.Bagaimana cara melacak paket saya?: How do I track my parcel?
en.Bagaimana memilih PUDO untuk pembeli say: How do I choose a PUDO for my buyers?
en.Bagaimana tren volume paket bulanan?: What is the monthly parcel volume trend?
en.Baris Tabel 4 dijumlahkan ulang; total e: Table 4 rows are re-summed; the document's e-commerce total (641) differs from the row sum (651). The row-sum result is canonical.
en.Base replacement; hanya discount rate di: Base replacement; only the discount rate varies.
en.Basis biaya & penjualan dari Table 3 kas: Cost and sales basis from case Table 3; volume +21.4% from Table 4. The fixed-cost share, lever shares, and overlap correction are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled). Absolute cost RISES because volume rises; what falls is cost-to-sales. 'EBIT proxy' = sales minus logistics cost (not official EBIT).
en.Batas kas per kurir + setor berkala: Cash limit per courier plus periodic deposits
en.Benchmark nasional: Pertamax capacity-we: National benchmark: capacity-weighted Pertamax across 23 hubs, national PLN B-2/TR tariff, Indonesian EV/ICE market prices, battery-as-a-service. Utilisation, efficiency, charging loss, and discount rate are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (scenario-tested). Maintenance sits outside the headline (fleet data unavailable).
en.Berapa lama tunggu kurir?: How long until the courier arrives?
en.Biaya = indeks relatif antar-region (pro: Cost = a relative index between regions (prototype proxy), not real tariffs. Constraints: source = hubs above 65% utilisation (critical threshold); receiver = hubs below 50% utilisation (headroom); safe floor 60%, maximum 35% shifted.
en.Biaya tumbuh lebih cepat dari sales (202: Costs grew faster than sales (2020 to 2023)
en.Biaya/emisi/kecepatan per moda = ASUMSI: Cost, emissions, and speed per mode are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (the case document contains no tariffs). Corridor distances follow the geography of the 23 hubs. The baseline is each corridor's default mode; the saving percentage counts only corridors that actually switch modes.
en.Bila sering tak di rumah, arahkan ke tit: If you are often away from home, route it to the nearest PUDO point so you can collect it whenever it suits you.
en.Breakeven replacement tidak ditemukan (N: No replacement break-even was found (NPV positive at every tested point) because the replacement scenario assumes the EV substitutes an ICE purchase. The most operational threshold is the INCREMENTAL break-even.
en.COD bernilai kecil dialihkan ke titik am: Small-value COD is diverted to a pick-up point so the courier does not wait.
en.COD memakai 138 menit untuk 8 paket vs 7: COD takes 138 minutes for 8 parcels against 75 minutes for non-COD. Have exact change ready to speed up delivery.
en.Capex hub baru Rp500 miliar dibandingkan: New-hub capex of Rp500 billion compared on an equivalent basis: average hub capacity 0.2217 million parcels per day.
en.Carbon accounting per rute + Modal shift: Carbon accounting per route plus modal shift to sea plus a 3-phase roadmap: baseline, then 50 EV, then 200 EV, plus an 8-year replacement policy.
en.Clustering rute paket COD sejenis (zero: Route clustering of similar COD parcels (zero idle between homes)
en.Coba ulang atau titip: Retry or leave with a neighbour
en.Complaint rate 5,5 per juta paket. Alama: Complaint rate 5.5 per million parcels. Ambiguous addresses (Figure 1: the same street in 3 different cities). Multimodal coordination keeps getting more complex.
en.Complaint rate jaringan 5,5 per juta pak: Network complaint rate 5.5 per million parcels. Precise addresses and clear arrival estimates hold down returns.
en.Demand Forecasting per hub + kapasitas e: Per-hub demand forecasting plus three-tier flexible capacity (trough, normal, peak) plus demand-source diversification.
en.Di atas 92%; bila gagal fee ditahan dan: Above 92%; on failure the fee is withheld and a 30-day takeover follows
en.Di hari biasa mungkin masih bisa dikejar: On an ordinary day it may still be catchable. But when parcels are heavy, 10 minutes at one home can cost us several deliveries after it.
en.Direct Operation: kantor pusat memiliki: Direct Operation: headquarters owns and manages every asset (hubs, outlets, fleet) centrally. Regional Sponsor: a local partnership with equity participation and greater operational autonomy, but headquarters loses full control over local pricing strategy.
en.Direct-vs-Sponsor Comparator (unit-cost: Direct-vs-Sponsor Comparator (unit-cost model from Tables 3 and 4)
en.Ekonomi dihitung dari angka kasus (biaya: Economics are computed from the case figures (cost and volume). Fixed shares, HQ equity, and local margin are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS and can be adjusted; not real tariffs.
en.Escrow / pre-pay untuk paket berisiko: Escrow or pre-pay for risky parcels
en.Estimasi siklus hidup order-of-magnitude: An order-of-magnitude lifecycle estimate: vehicle and battery production (one-off) plus 5 years of operation. Production figures are team assumptions (labelled), not a certified LCA. Purpose: show whether and when the EV carbon benefit turns positive once production is counted.
en.Fee mitra (JV 26%, sponsor penuh 22%) da: Partner fee (JV 26%, full sponsor 22%) and tier split are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS. Saving = related revenue x (GC cost ratio 31.34% minus partner fee). The national cost ratio is applied to eastern hubs that actually carry higher fixed costs, so this estimate is conservative. Not a contract outcome.
en.Fitur kalender musiman, kalender platfor: Seasonal calendar features, platform calendar, and regulatory calendar; target out-of-sample MAPE of 5% to 8% with walk-forward validation.
en.Fluktuasi 78-105M/bulan (34,6%). E-comme: Fluctuation of 78 to 105 million per month (34.6%). E-commerce fell 29.8% during the TikTok Shop suspension from September to October 2023. Java hubs overloaded during Double 12 2022.
en.Fulfilment expense naik 54,9% (Rp32,34T→: Fulfilment expense rose 54.9% (from Rp32.34 trillion to Rp50.08 trillion) between 2020 and 2023, while net sales rose only 48.7% (from Rp213.64 trillion to Rp317.63 trillion). This 6.2-point gap was driven by a 23.9x expansion of network partners (20 to 478) without testing demand continuity.
Fulfilment expense rose 54.9% (from Rp32.34 trillion to Rp50.08 trillion) against net sales up 48.7%. Loss in 2023. Jakarta utilisation 90.4% against Jayapura 28.1%.
en.GC Logistics mencatat rugi di 2023, lalu: GC Logistics recorded a loss in 2023, then adjusted EBIT turned positive again in 2024. The cost-to-sales ratio stayed relatively stable (30.9% to 31.3%), but the overly fast network expansion of 2021 to 2023 made operations complex.
en.Geotag + fuzzy matching menekan retur ga: Geotagging plus fuzzy matching hold down failed-delivery returns and complaints.
en.Halo Baits! Rute non-COD hari ini selesa: Hello Baits! Today's non-COD route finished in about 75 minutes. But COD takes 138 minutes, 84% longer. My suggestion: cluster COD parcels on a separate route.
en.Halo Dalila. Pendapatan naik 48,7% sejak: Hello Dalila. Revenue is up 48.7% since 2020, but fulfilment cost is up 54.9%, 6.2 points faster. EBIT only recovered in 2024. Want to see the cost breakdown by category?
en.Halo Marwah, hub Bandung hari ini 68,9%: Hello Marwah, the Bandung hub is at 68.9% today, 3.9 points above the threshold. Demand is forecast to rise 8% next week. Prepare a seasonal courier buffer.
en.Headroom = (kapasitas − permintaan) × 36: Headroom = (capacity minus demand) x 365 on two bases: conservative 2024 (1.46 billion parcels) and Table 1. Contribution per parcel of Rp3,000 is a TEAM ASSUMPTION (range Rp2,000 to 6,000). Payback per pathway is a TEAM ESTIMATE, not case data.
en.Hentikan kontrak fleksibel, alihkan volu: Stop flexible contracts, shift volume to the lowest-variable-cost hubs, and freeze recruitment.
en.Hub Jakarta punya utilisasi 90,4% (terti: The Jakarta hub runs at 90.4% utilisation (the highest of the 23 hubs) and sometimes exceeds capacity, especially during shopping festivals such as Double 12 2022. Jayapura sits at only 28.1%, a 62.3-point gap.
en.Hub Jawa rata-rata 69,4%. Bandung masih: Java hubs average 69.4%. Bandung is still below Surabaya (71.8%) but above Semarang (65.9%).
en.Hub mana yang bisa menampung overflow?: Which hub can absorb the overflow?
en.Hub pengirim di atas 78% memindahkan beb: Source hubs above 78% shift load to receiving hubs below 55%; safe floor of 60% at the receiver; at most 35% of load shifted.
en.Insentif output + QRIS/konfirmasi pra-ke: Output incentives plus QRIS and pre-arrival confirmation reduce time per COD parcel.
en.Isi alamat lengkap + patokan. 'Jl. Raya: Enter the full address plus a landmark. 'Jl. Raya Jakarta-Bogor No.12' can point to 3 different cities.
en.Isi muatan balik dan berbagi kapasitas m: Filling return loads and sharing capacity reduces empty trips.
en.Isi ruang kosong hub eksisting: Fill the empty space in existing hubs
en.Jakarta 90,4% — di atas ambang. Sementar: Jakarta 90.4%, above the threshold. Jayapura is only 28.1%. A 62.3-point gap.
en.Kalau COD lebih susah. Kita bukan cuma a: COD is harder. We are not just delivering a parcel; we have to wait until the person is ready to pay. If we have to wait, the next stop runs late too.
en.Kalau sampai rumah tapi orangnya belum a: If we arrive and nobody is home, we have no choice but to wait. Sometimes five minutes, sometimes 15 to 20.
en.Kapan pakai PUDO vs antar rumah?: When do we use a PUDO instead of home delivery?
en.Kapasitas fixed + demand tunggal: Fixed capacity plus a single demand view
en.Kemasan sekali-pakai salah satu driver b: Single-use packaging is one driver of fulfilment cost and material emissions.
en.Kemasan sesuai ukuran menurunkan biaya m: Right-sized packaging reduces material cost and waste.
en.Kenapa COD berisiko untuk penjual?: Why is COD risky for sellers?
en.Kenapa COD lebih lambat dari pengiriman: Why is COD slower than ordinary delivery?
en.Kenapa biaya naik lebih cepat dari sales: Why are costs rising faster than sales?
en.Kirim ke GCMS harian tanpa pengecualian: Send to GCMS daily without exception
en.Komplain 5,5/juta -> target <3/juta; tia: Complaints 5.5 per million, target below 3 per million; every return is one wasted trip.
en.Konfirmasi slot atau tawarkan PUDO: Confirm a slot or offer a PUDO
en.Konsumsi EV & efisiensi ICE base-case te: EV consumption and base-case ICE efficiency stay fixed; only distance varies.
en.Kritis, tetapi belum ada mekanisme konfi: Critical, but no confirmation mechanism exists yet
en.Kurir dibayar flat per paket, sehingga m: Couriers are paid a flat rate per parcel, so delivering COD properly lowers their daily income. The rational behaviour becomes avoiding COD, reducing verification, or refusing on the spot, which produces returns.
en.Kurir memulai perjalanan dari Hub Jakart: The courier sets off from the Jakarta Hub. The parcel is tracked in real time.
en.Link pre-payment (bayar sebelum kurir da: Pre-payment link (pay before the courier arrives)
en.Load balancing jauh lebih murah daripada: Load balancing is far cheaper than building a new hub, and it defers capex.
en.Load factor line-haul & kolaborasi kapas: Line-haul load factor and capacity collaboration between operators.
en.Market-Expansion Plan (ruang kosong jari: Market-Expansion Plan (network empty space x contribution per parcel)
en.Mitra wajib +30% dengan notifikasi 48 ja: Partners must supply +30% with 48 hours' notice and are paid when used; on-demand couriers; PUDO when a hub exceeds 85%.
en.Modal shift darat ke laut: Modal shift from road to sea
en.Modal-Shift Optimizer: hemat biaya & emi: Modal-Shift Optimizer: cost and emissions savings on corridors that switch modes.
en.Model hibrida berbasis utilisasi wilayah: A utilisation-based hybrid model: Java stays Direct Operation, Kalimantan and Sulawesi move to Regional Sponsor in stages, Maluku and Papua fully. Digital Twin of 23 hubs.
en.Monte Carlo deterministik (seed tetap) a: Deterministic Monte Carlo (fixed seed) over utilisation, fuel and electricity prices, battery lease, EV consumption, and ICE efficiency. An uncertainty simulation, not a forecast; change the seed to see sample variation.
en.Motor 93,7% armada (12.500 unit). Target: Motorcycles are 93.7% of the fleet (12,500 units). The 200 EV target is only 1.4% of the 14,180 total.
en.Nilai yang dapat diturunkan dari data do: What can be derived from the document data: courier time savings (Rp2,089 per COD parcel, 35% mix) = Rp0.81 trillion per year. The working figure of Rp1.95 trillion adds prevented returns and reconciliation differences (labelled team assumptions), because return costs and cash values are not available in the case.
en.Normal terpangkas (truncated normal) ke: Normal truncated to the physical range; the base case is the mean.
en.One-way sensitivity: tiap lever divarias: One-way sensitivity: each lever is varied on its own (ceteris paribus). Swing = |NPV high minus NPV low|.
en.PUDO / ambil di gerai (kurir tak menungg: PUDO or outlet pick-up (the courier does not wait at home)
en.PUDO atau loker untuk COD kecil: PUDO or a locker for small COD
en.PUDO saat hub di atas 85% (sistem lima l: PUDO when a hub exceeds 85% (five-layer system, Challenge 2).
en.Paket COD berisiko dikelompokkan dan diu: Risky COD parcels are grouped and sequenced instead of scattered at random.
en.Paket nilai tinggi di jam malam dengan a: High-value parcels at night with ambiguous addresses fail COD most often, risk score above 65%.
en.Paket tidak mendesak dialihkan ke laut/k: Non-urgent parcels shift to sea or ship (cheaper and lower emissions).
en.Peak-Surge Stress-Test (Table 1 kapasita: Peak-Surge Stress-Test (Table 1 capacity x peak amplification)
en.Pembagian A dan B tidak semata mengikuti: The A and B split does not follow utilisation alone: Makassar (48.6%) stays Direct as the Sulawesi gateway and eastern consolidation point; tier C is purely the lowest utilisation.
en.Pembayaran nontunai menghapus waktu meng: Cashless payment removes the time spent counting money and change.
en.Penerima siap saat kurir tiba; menunggu: The recipient is ready when the courier arrives; waiting at the door disappears.
en.Perluasan bertahap ke hub regional; sisa: Staged expansion to regional hubs; the rest wait for validated utilisation.
en.Pertanyaan utama bukan 'apakah EV lebih: The real question is not 'is the EV cheaper?' (EV energy is far cheaper in every scenario) but 'WHEN and WHERE should GC replace ICE with EV?' Economics depend heavily on utilisation and asset replacement timing. The extreme payback in the replacement scenario must NOT become the headline without counterfactual context.
en.Pilot 1 kota padat (Jadetabek) — validas: Pilot in 1 dense city (Jadetabek): validate utilisation, charging, BaaS.
en.Porsi EV target = 1,41% dari armada: Target EV share = 1.41% of the fleet
en.Porsi per tuas = ASUMSI TIM sebagai pers: Per-lever shares are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS as a percentage of variable cost after growth (volume +21.4%); they are used for relative prioritisation, not a firm projection. The lever table is canonical (identical to the P&L Waterfall).
en.Predictive COD + clustering rute COD + P: Predictive COD plus COD route clustering plus a PUDO Network plus digital reconciliation. Courier compensation per service task.
en.Region mana yang cocok untuk sponsor mod: Which regions suit the sponsor model?
en.Rekonsiliasi kas tiga arah antara bukti: Three-way cash reconciliation between handover proof, courier wallet transfers, and merchant records.
en.Replacement scenario; 60 km/hari = asums: Replacement scenario; 60 km per day is an assumption that must be validated through a pilot.
en.Replikasi ke kota besar ber-utilisasi ti: Replicate to large high-utilisation cities (Java, Sumatra).
en.Rina, margin bulan ini sehat tapi 2 dari: Rina, margins are healthy this month but 2 of your 10 orders risk failed delivery (high COD). Set the PUDO threshold to hold down returns.
en.Route Intelligence (kepadatan BPR + efis: Route Intelligence (BPR density plus cost, time, and emissions efficiency)
en.Rute COD 138 min vs non-COD 75 min (+84%: COD routes 138 min against non-COD 75 min (+84%). COD productivity 3.48 parcels per hour against 6.4 (54.3%). Cash reconciliation is complex and prone to human error.
en.SIMULASI/prototipe: koefisien dampak (ut: SIMULATION/prototype: impact coefficients (utilisation +15 points, capex x0.35, on-time -3 points per 100% sponsor) are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS; eastern base utilisation and 2023 fulfilment come from case data.
en.Sampai mana paket saya sekarang?: Where is my parcel right now?
en.Sari, 3 paket COD-mu sedang dalam pengan: Sari, 3 of your COD parcels are out for delivery today. COD routes average 138 minutes; choose slot confirmation so the courier does not wait.
en.Simulasi Direct Operation vs Regional Sp: The Direct Operation against Regional Sponsor simulation is ready to try. Move the slider to see the impact on cost and utilisation.
en.Simulasi rollout 3 fase atas basis 12.50: A 3-phase rollout simulation on a base of 12,500 motorcycles (case data). Per-unit economics use the base replacement scenario; units per phase are cumulative fractions. This is staged guidance, not a simultaneous capex commitment.
en.Simulasi telemetri kurir realistis berda: A realistic courier telemetry simulation based on BPR curves, weather models, and the energy consumption profile of electric (EV) and fuel last-mile vehicles.
en.Simulator yang menguji skenario Direct O: A simulator that tests the Direct Operation Model against the Regional Sponsor Model before a decision is taken. Move the sliders to see the impact on fixed cost, utilisation, and on-time rate per region.
en.Skor pelanggan memakai recency, frekuens: Customer scores use recency, frequency, and spend. Incentivise transfers for customers at high COD risk.
en.Sponsor atau Joint Venture di kota tier-: Sponsor or Joint Venture in tier-2 and tier-3 cities
en.TCO/km 5-tahun (base, replacement). ICE: 5-year TCO per km (base, replacement). ICE uses public maintenance benchmarks (assumption); EV uses BaaS plus maintenance near zero and amortises the vehicle price difference. A simulation, not actual fleet data.
en.Tantangan 3: COD 17,25 -> 12,0 menit per: Challenge 3: COD 17.25 to 12.0 minutes per parcel; productivity 24.3 to 35 per day.
en.Target 200 EV hanya 1,4% dari 14.180 arm: The 200 EV target is only 1.4% of the 14,180 fleet. A purchase-based approach does not change operational decisions.
en.Tarif rata-rata Rp10.000 dan biaya varia: An average tariff of Rp10,000 and variable cost of Rp7,000 give a contribution of Rp3,000; a 10 percent tariff cut (Rp1,000) reduces contribution to about Rp2,000.
en.Tingkat kepadatan, kecepatan, biaya tol,: Density level, speed, toll cost, fuel consumption, and emissions are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled), not live traffic data. The travel-time model uses BPR curves (delay proportional to a·(v/c)^b).
en.Titik ambil/pengiriman menurunkan percob: Pick-up and delivery points reduce failed delivery attempts.
en.Ubah kontrak line-haul dari minimum volu: Change line-haul contracts from minimum volume to per-trip, defer non-critical capex.
en.Unit economics (margin kontribusi/paket): Unit economics (contribution margin per parcel) from Tables 3 and 4. Capex per hub, variable-cost share, target utilisation, and the year-1 capture rate are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled). Headroom is computed up to a safe utilisation target (not 100%), and year-1 realisation is capped by the demand-growth capture rate.
en.Virgiawan, komplain turun didorong perba: Virgiawan, complaints are down thanks to better addresses. 3 new ambiguous addresses need verification: Jl. Raya Jakarta-Bogor No.12 in Cibinong, Depok, and Tangsel.
en.Volume COD dari Table 4 (e-commerce shar: COD volume from Table 4 (e-commerce share) x assumed COD share. Human-error rate, reconciliation time, discrepancy cost, AOV, and intervention impact are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled); the document only states the process is 'complex, time-consuming, prone to human error'.
en.Waktu dasar dari Figure 2 kasus (8 paket: Base durations from case Figure 2 (8 parcels: 75 minutes non-COD, 138 minutes COD). Courier tariff, COD mix, potential saving per intervention, and realisation are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS (labelled). Annual working values use additional components labelled as assumptions.
en.COD Cash-Reconciliation Risk (Table 4 vo: COD Cash-Reconciliation Risk (Table 4 volume x cash-error assumption)
en.Efek eskalasi harga tahunan pada NPV bas: The effect of annual price escalation on the base NPV (replacement). Cash flow grows and the NPV is recomputed.
en.Flat juga, tanpa kompensasi waktu dan ri: Also flat, with no compensation for time or cash risk
en.Motor listrik menggantikan BBM pada rute: Electric motorcycles replace fuel on urban routes (only at scale).
en.Pilot 350 unit Tantangan 4 = sekitar 0,0: The 350-unit pilot in Challenge 4 is about 0.004% to 0.005% of variable cost.
en.Prototipe presentasi: model Logistic Reg: Presentation prototype: the Logistic Regression model is trained on SYNTHETIC data; the policy thresholds (0.35/0.65) and pickupWaitMin are TEAM ASSUMPTIONS. The score is not a production output.
en.Selisih 10 unit pada dokumen kasus; kami: A 10-unit difference in the case document; we use the row-sum result.

en.Mengalihkan sebagian paket dari hub yang: Shifting some parcels from a full hub to another hub that still has room. A real example: during Double 12 2022, Jakarta Hub 1 diverted some parcels to other hubs because it was at capacity.
en.Unified Cost-Waterfall & P&L Impact (jem: Unified Cost-Waterfall & P&L Impact (absorption bridge plus levers)
en.Basis harian dari Table 4 (1.110 juta/36: Daily basis from Table 4 (1,110 million / 365). The '>3 million per day' peak comes from the document (Double 12 2022). en.Horizon 5 tahun, diskonto 10%, pembebasa: 5-year horizon, 10% discount rate, EV tax exemption included in the base case. Market prices are labelled external and need re-verification; the 350-unit pilot is 2.8% of the fleet.
en.Net benefit per tahun (Rp175 per km): Net benefit per year (Rp175 per km)
en.Tidak ada periode balik modal karena aru: There is no payback period because the Year-0 cash flow is already positive.
en.Total agregat, BCR, ROI, dan rasio TCO b: Aggregate totals, BCR, ROI, and the TCO ratio are sourced from the analysis document (its per-class rows are already rounded).
